mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede corporate earnings declines and trigger negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of periods when UNRATE rises by at least 0.2pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is at or below 0.25%, it signals an ultra-loose monetary policy that compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdowns (INDPRO decline), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced corporate investment and earnings growth, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of periods when INDPRO declines > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) typically leads to higher real interest rates and reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.3% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 50,000 signals weakening labor demand, which typically precedes corporate profit deterioration and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines > 50,000 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline by at least 0.2% quarter-over-quarter.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of strong retail sales (RSAFS), the S&P 500 tends to outperform due to elevated consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods when RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 1 month.
